units.source_text: 薰大将来时随带着浮舟的弟弟小君童子。

en.t: When General Kaoru came, he brought Ukifune's younger brother, the boy Kogimi, with him.

units.source_text: 这童子的相貌生得比其他弟兄清秀。

en.t: The boy's features were more refined than those of his other brothers.

units.source_text: 此时薰大将召唤他前来，对僧都说道：

en.t: At this point General Kaoru called him over and said to the Sozu:

units.source_text: “这孩子和那人是同胞，先派他去吧。

en.t: "This child is her full brother, so let us send him first.

units.source_text: 可否请你备一封介绍信？

en.t: Could you prepare a letter of introduction?

units.source_text: 不须说出我的名字，但言有人要来访问就是了。”

en.t: There is no need to mention my name; simply say that someone wishes to visit."

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“贫僧倘做介绍，势必造成罪孽。

en.t: The Sozu replied, "If I were to make such an introduction, I would surely be creating sin.

units.source_text: 此事前后情况，既已详细奉告，则大将只须自行前往，

en.t: Since I have already told you the whole matter in detail, you need only go there yourself,

units.source_text: 依照尊意行事，有何不可？”

en.t: and act as you see fit; what objection could there be?"

units.source_text: 薰大将笑道：“你说做此介绍势必造成罪孽，使我颇感羞惭。

en.t: General Kaoru laughed and said, "When you say that making this introduction would surely create sin, I feel quite ashamed.

units.source_text: 我身沉浮俗世之中，直至今日，真乃意外之事。

en.t: That I have drifted along in the secular world until today is truly unexpected.

units.source_text: 我自幼深怀出家之志，只因三条院家母生涯岑寂，

en.t: Since childhood I have deeply wished to leave the world, but because my mother at Sanjo-in led such a lonely life,

units.source_text: 惟与我这一个不肖之子相依为命，这就成了难于摆脱的羁绊，

en.t: and depended for her very existence on me, her one unworthy son, that became a bond hard to escape,

units.source_text: 致使我身缠上了俗世之事。

en.t: causing me to become entangled in worldly affairs.

units.source_text: 这期间自然升高了官位，使我行动不能随心所欲，

en.t: Meanwhile my rank naturally rose, so that I could no longer act as I pleased,

units.source_text: 空怀着道心而因循度日。

en.t: and I passed the days aimlessly, cherishing only an empty aspiration for the Way.

units.source_text: 于是世俗应有之事日渐增多。

en.t: In this way the obligations of worldly life grew day by day.

units.source_text: 不论公私，凡是不可避免之事，我都随俗应酬。

en.t: Whether public or private, whatever could not be avoided I handled according to worldly custom.

units.source_text: 若是可避免的，则竭尽浅陋之知识，恪守佛法之戒律，

en.t: When something could be avoided, I used what little understanding I had and strictly kept the precepts of the Buddha's law,

units.source_text: 务求不犯过失。

en.t: striving not to commit any fault.

units.source_text: 自问学道之心，实不亚于高僧。

en.t: When I ask myself about my devotion to the Way, I believe it is truly no less than that of an eminent monk.

units.source_text: 何况为了区区儿女柔情之事，岂肯干犯重罪！

en.t: How then could I be willing to commit a grave sin for a mere matter of romantic feeling!

units.source_text: 此乃决不会有之事，请勿怀疑。

en.t: Such a thing would never happen; please do not doubt it.

units.source_text: 只因可怜她的母亲正在悲伤愁叹，所以想把所闻情状传告，

en.t: It is only because I pity her mother, who is grieving and lamenting, that I wish to tell her what I have heard,

units.source_text: 使她得知详实。

en.t: so that she may know the details accurately.

units.source_text: 但得如此，我心不胜欣慰了。”

en.t: If only I can do that, my heart will be greatly comforted."

units.source_text: 他叙述了从小以来深信佛法的心愿。

en.t: He spoke of the wish he had held since childhood, rooted in deep faith in the Buddha's law.

units.source_text: 僧都认为确是实情，心甚赞善，对他说了许多尊贵的佛理。

en.t: The Sozu believed this was indeed the truth, admired him deeply, and spoke to him at length about noble Buddhist teachings.

units.source_text: 其间天色渐暮，薰大将思量此时顺路赴小野投宿，机会正好。

en.t: Meanwhile the sky gradually darkened, and General Kaoru thought this would be a good chance to stop at Ono for the night on his way.

units.source_text: 然而毫无关系，贸然前往，毕竟有所不便。

en.t: Yet since he had no connection there, it would still be awkward to go calling so abruptly.

units.source_text: 心烦意乱了一会，思量不如返京都去。

en.t: After feeling troubled and unsettled for a while, he decided it would be better to return to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 此时僧都注目于浮舟之弟小君，正在赞誉他。

en.t: Just then the Sozu had turned his attention to Ukifune's younger brother Kogimi and was praising him.

units.source_text: 薰大将便告道：“就委托这孩子，请你略写数行交他送去吧。”

en.t: General Kaoru then said, "Let us entrust it to this child; please write a few lines and give them to him to deliver."

units.source_text: 僧都便写了信，交付小君，对他说道：

en.t: The Sozu then wrote the letter, handed it to Kogimi, and said to him:

units.source_text: “今后你常常到山上来玩吧。

en.t: "From now on, come up to the mountain often to visit.

units.source_text: 须知我对你不是没有因缘的。”

en.t: You should know that there is no lack of karmic connection between you and me."

units.source_text: 这孩子并不懂得这句话的意思，只是接受了信，随着薰大将出门赴小野去。

en.t: The child did not understand what these words meant; he simply accepted the letter and went out with General Kaoru toward Ono.

units.source_text: 到了那里，薰大将叫随从人等稍稍散开，叮嘱大家静些。

en.t: When they arrived there, General Kaoru had his attendants spread out a little and instructed everyone to be quiet.
